concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-method-nonce-create-node]] - Node.js server-side payment-method nonce creation from a payment-method token, with the explicit restriction to 3D Secure or Checkout with PayPal and the missing-payment-method error route
warnings: Preserve the page's should-only restriction: server-side payment-method nonce creation is limited here to 3D Secure or Checkout with PayPal.
Keep the operation scoped to the Node.js server SDK and do not present nonce creation as transaction creation, payment authorization, or payment success.
